dex.entry: A little moon-tide sprite shaped like a water-drop with a crescent inside; it skips across wet rooftops in Nightreach when the moon is high, riding the silver reflections of puddles. A moon caught inside a raindrop — the most delicate little thing, made of two beautiful things at once.

art.silhouette: Teardrop body, translucent cool-blue with a glowing silver crescent suspended inside, tiny stub feet, round hopeful eyes; simple and lovely at 32px.
